Hi! I am a **Research Scientist** at the [Center for Open Geographical Science (COGS)](https://cogs.sdsu.edu/), San Diego State University (USA), and an **Assistant Researcher** at the [Subtropical Biology Institute (IBS, CONICET–UNaM)](https://ibs.conicet.gov.ar/velazco-santiago/), Argentina.

My work sits at the intersection of **conservation ecology, biogeography, and spatial modelling**. I develop and apply species distribution models to understand how climate change, land use and fire shape biodiversity, and to help decide *where* and *how* to protect it. I also build open-source tools —such as [flexsdm](https://sjevelazco.github.io/flexsdm/), [adm](https://sjevelazco.github.io/adm/) and [bdc](https://brunobrr.github.io/bdc/)— so that robust biodiversity modelling is accessible to everyone.

I have taught and mentored students in graduate programs across Argentina, Brazil, and beyond, and I co-lead the [EcoCode](https://geobon.org/ecocode-modelling-life-on-earth/) working group on biodiversity modelling.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Research interests:** species distribution & abundance models · model extrapolation and uncertainty · protected areas and conservation planning · global change biology · Neotropical biodiversity · open science & reproducible software
:::
